content: STAGE 1 — scope/placement review setup. Goal: locate the frozen evidence bundle detail and any workspace artefacts before ranking the four proposals. Read: working directory listing and the in-prompt evidence digests for all four IDs (SUCC-GEO-CBTAB 8bef1936fe52fe0d, BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS 59d5537a06b2c42e, MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ c533b1153c3faa6e, poincare-frechet-successor-codebook 3a34d4b40fe8f322). Observed: each bundle shares the same OBSERVED block (E4-E11) and differs only in the PROPOSED E1/E2/E3/E12/E13 text. The shared observations are: successor entropy strongly stratified (top1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973), width-20 beam survival l1_br 0.04671 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 vs l1_only 0.06233 vs resample 0.06363, per-position NLL showing l1_br collapses at T4 (9.03) while euclid/resample distribute, first-level capacity ceiling K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 (negatives 0.1352/0.0129), train-only cohort profile positive 0.9291 vs negative 0.8871 and 0.5898 per-pair win rate, mean outgoing degree 5.45 with 115582 distinct edges, baseline same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067. Still open: read individual full bundle files if present, then judge each proposal against the five scope criteria and the one-run/no-sweep policy.

STAGE 2 - final placement (complete answer appended at end). Ranked all four against the five scope criteria and the one-run/no-ablation policy using the shared OBSERVED block.

Evidence used: E6/E7 - successor-geometry arms lose (successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, _v2 0.05463, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, successor_entropy 0.05122) against near-baseline 0.06207-0.06363 (l1_br_euclid, l1_only, resample); l1_br over-shares prefixes (alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068) yet gives T4 NLL 9.03 and recall 0.04671, while resample wins with T1 4.55 / T4 0.05 (wide root, deterministic depth). E5 - successor entropy stratified, top1 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973. E8 - level-1 granularity dominates co-location (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822). E9 - cohort profile 0.9291 vs 0.8871, 0.5898 per-pair. E10 - 115,582 of 118,315 edges unique (0.977), mean out-degree 5.45. E11 - baseline same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs null 0.067.

Reasoning: PFS first - curvature acts in both geodesic assignment and commitment and the same weight drives the Fréchet codebook step (tightest criterion-3 coupling), fully specified with tanh bound and log-map residual chain, eta=1 so no lag in 3000 epochs. BFRQ second - Euclidean assignment dodges the measured 0.055 curved-arm penalty and constants are derived (tau, 99th pct, c=1) but E12 names d_c while the unchanged assignment never calls it, so curvature is a one-step Karcher contraction with admitted inertness/centre-crowding against E8. MIXCURV third - cleanest switch statement but C_i is unmeasured in the bundle and E10's mean out-degree 5.45 leaves most items at the k<5 prior g=0.5 (gate inert for tail); E12 k_H<0 init -1 contradicts spec softplus init +1.0. SUCC-GEO fourth - best-evidenced signal (E5) but the exact family measured worst in E6/E7 (l1_br 0.04671 with T4 NLL 9.03), its own duplicate-code risk (c), and an un-derived triplet margin under a pointer spec - breaks the derived-constant/no-sweep policy.

No ablation arm trained; diagnostics non-gating; Stage3 test_recall@10 remains the judgement. Complete answer:
RANK: poincare-frechet-successor-codebook | position=1 | reason=one train-only weight drives geodesic assignment, geodesic commitment and the per-slot Frechet codebook step, so removing behaviour or curvature changes the core computation, not a suffix; only spec with a stated safeguard (tanh-bounded ball points, log-map residual chain, eta=1 so 3000 epochs cannot lag), on E5's stratified successor structure and E10's 115,582 sparse directed edges.
RANK: BFRQ-KARCHER-MASS | position=2 | reason=Euclidean assignment dodges the curved arms measured at 0.055 in E6 and its constants are derived (tau=median||z||, 99th-pct clip, c=1), but E12 names d_c while the unchanged assignment never evaluates it, so curvature is only a one-step Karcher contraction - the near-inert/centre-crowding failure its own risks admit - against E8's level-1 granularity result.
RANK: MIXCURV-FIBRE-RQ | position=3 | reason=cleanest switch statement (removing behaviour collapses to unweighted product, removing curvature to weighted Euclidean) but C_i is measured nowhere in the bundle (E5/E9 measure successor entropy and cohort profiles) and E10's mean out-degree 5.45 leaves most items at the k<5 prior g=0.5, so the gate is inert for the tail; E12 k_H<0 init -1 contradicts the spec's softplus init at +1.0.
RANK: SUCC-GEO-CBTAB | position=4 | reason=best-evidenced signal (E5 top-1 0.4375 vs 0.0543) but the family already measured losing (E6 successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, _v2 0.05463, tangent 0.05500, l1_br 0.04671 with prefixes alive 1.000/1.000/1.000 yet T4 NLL 9.03 in E7 - its own duplicate-code risk); pointer spec with an un-derived triplet margin breaks the derived-constant policy.
